_comment: DS §15 — this repo's declaration of what the XSS rule covers.
Product source only. build/build.mjs is tooling and is globally ignored.
why: html.js is the HTML export surface (htmlPage, wordHtml, printDoc). core.js is renderHTML/escapeHtml. common.js is the shared helpers those call. Not build/build.mjs — tooling, globally ignored, and naming it would be the uploadwizard-app failure mode (a green count on files that do not render HTML).
